text:
alex: FYI — after yesterday's kernel rollout to the new fused-attn+kv path, we're seeing a p95 latency regression (~20-30%) on Qwen-7B when AWQ int8 + RoPE scale=1.5 is used in streaming mode. Link to perf job: https://ci.internal/redwood/perf/17715

maria: oh no. is it across all batch sizes?

alex: mostly at small batch sizes (1-4). bulk throughput for batch>=16 looks fine. latency hurt on 1-token streaming and early decode.

sam: can you paste the profiling output? especially kernel timings and KV copy times.

alex: pasted below (from perf-run-17715):

```
Model: qwen-7b-awq-rope1.5
HW: a100-40
Config: streaming, max_stream_tokens=512, batch=2
Timeline (ms):
  tokenize: 2.1
  forward_kernel: 18.6 (expected ~12)
  attn_kernels: 9.2
  kv_copy: 6.8 (was 1.2 before rollout)
  cuda_sync: 7.1
  total p95: 45.3 (baseline p95: 34.0)
```

kevin: kv_copy jump is suspicious. did kernel change move KV layout or add extra memcpy?

alex: looks like the fused-attn path uses interleaved KV layout for perf at large batches, we now do a non-paged staging copy for small batches which seems to kill p95.

maria: do other models (llama, mistral, mixtral) show same effect with AWQ?

alex: quick check: llama-2-7b-awq shows small regression (~5%), mistral-7b negligible, mixtral shows odd memory alignment stalls on same kernel. Qwen suffers most due to larger heads/kv dim layout (head_dim=128, kv_dim interleave pattern).

sam: could RoPE scaling interact? Qwen uses rope_scale=1.5, that changes index math and may change memory access stride.

nina: also recall AWQ calibration used a short prompt set. Did we re-run calibration after kernel change? AWQ quant params can be sensitive to accumulation order — maybe kernel reorder changed numerical error and we then fall into fallback code paths?

kevin: possible. if fallback code triggers extra memcpy or slower path, that explains kv_copy increase. ops-bot, did the rollout toggle any fallback flags?

ops-bot: deploy: fused-attn-kernel-v3 rolled to staging at 2026-03-17T22:10Z, flag fused_attn_v3=true for runtime pool 'g1'. No fallback flags were enabled at deploy time.

maria: temporary mitigation: pin runtime to fused-attn-kernel-v2 for customer-facing pools, and schedule deeper debug on v3. can someone create the revert PR?

sam: I can open the rollback PR in five minutes. Also: we should add a micro-benchmark that exercises small-batch streaming + AWQ + RoPE variants.

alex: agreed. add tests for batch sizes 1/2/4, rope_scale=[1.0,1.25,1.5], quant=[AWQ,GPTQ,int8]. We need per-kernel KV copy timings and whether we hit fallback paths.

kevin: long-term: kernel selection should consider model layout (heads, kv dim) and per-batch streaming SLOs. We should add a kernel_policy that prefers non-interleaved KV for head_dim>=128 and batch<=4.

nina: for quant stuff — re-run AWQ calibration with the fused-attn-kernel-v3 to detect numeric deltas. calibration prompt set: include 200 tokens from chat-like contexts and 200 tokens from bench Q/A. Track EM/acc deltas. We saw ~0.6% EM drop on SQuAD-like eval in previous suspect runs.

alex: quick command to rerun calibration locally:

```
python tools/quant_calibrate.py --model qwen-7b --method awq --kernel fused-attn-v3 --prompts data/calib/rope_mixed.json --out calib/qwen-awq-fusedv3.json
```

maria: also try GPTQ calibration as a comparator — sometimes AWQ wobble is worse on high head dims.

sam: action items: PR to rollback (sam), micro-bench harness (alex+kevin), AWQ re-calibrate on v3 (nina), add kernel_policy rule (kevin). I'll tag owners on the PR.

kevin: one more note — we should surface a warning in Console when a kernel selection leads to >10% p95 regression vs baseline for any model-quant-rope combo. That'd catch this earlier.

alex: agreed. also add a lightweight runtime metric 'kv_copy_ms' per request so we can alert.

nina: for accuracy logging, let's track calibration delta as a single metric: calib_em_delta_pct and attach to model-version metadata when we register quantized artifacts.

maria: ok, rolling back customer pools now. I'll update status when rollback completes.

ops-bot: rollback completed for pool 'g1' at 2026-03-18T01:32Z, fused_attn_v3 flag false.

alex: after rollback p95 returned to baseline for Qwen AWQ streaming. We'll keep v3 in staging until kernel policy and cal runs are done. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
